item.title: TWISTED SISTER’s 50th Anniversary Reunion Tour Canceled Due to Dee Snider’s Health
item.description: Twisted Sister, together with French Management Enterprises, have released an official statement announcing that the 50th Anniversary Reunion Tour unfortunately has to be canceled. The reason is serious health limitations affecting singer and rock legend Dee Snider.
